assessment_scope.original_sources: Original sources establish business obligations and unresolved decisions. Candidate assertions cannot establish source requirements.
assessment_scope.derived_evidence: Claims, associations, signals and dispositions are derived evidence. Their omissions or labels do not remove original obligations.
assessment_scope.instruction: Assess extraction and reconciliation against the complete assigned original source, including meaning with no surviving claim. Current candidate associations do not limit this assignment.

evidence_rules.instruction: For an omission, select the sources supporting the missing meaning. The bound subject fixes claim evidence; source-only omissions have no claim selection. Eligibility alone is not support.

requirements.task: All meaningful facts in source 1 survive extraction and reconciliation, including identity, obligations, conditions and constraints. Preserve source uncertainty; assess loss, not whether specification fields can be generated.

sources.text:
When smoke is detected, the controller must sound the alarm.
While smoke persists, the controller must keep the exit door unlocked.
The building log must record the sensor calibration version.

segments: The controller must display the current smoke reading.
The building log must record the sensor calibration version.
